T0.OFF_charge_policy: Original absolute logic midpoint at OFF rising edge defines disabled logical interval; full transition charge also separately reported. Integrate positive, negative and absolute magnitudes without cancellation.
T0.ON_feedthrough_policy: Non-commanded excess over original +10% measured-reference current envelope, plus negative output current; ordinary commanded ON transfer is reported separately.
T0.current_limit_source: Original MIRROR_TOL=10% applied to actual physically measured reference resistor current, unchanged copy W/L scale; all actual working-output channel plateaus tested. Low output separately reported, not claimed ideal current source.
T0.reference_perturbation_basis: Original certificate DELTA_V=20mV allowance; peak deviation after24ms from pre-ON22-24ms baseline. Both ilimp_n and irefp_n, including switching transients.
T0.establishment_basis: 5% of original shortest certified pulse (5.08ms), reserve95% for physical pulse transfer; after external1ms edge. No result-dependent extension.
T0.model_domain: Every MOS: abs(Vsb)<2V; abs(Vgb),abs(Vdb)<3.3V; original W/L ranges. Entire0-60ms.
T0.port_energy: All actual MOS terminal currents and voltages, reference resistor currents, output boundary and supply currents saved.
T0.boundary_voltage_source_policy: Fixed testbench output PWLs only, not inserted into formal circuit; no source forces cg or internal selector state.

stop_policy: first science/engineering failure, no retry, no parameter scan
